name: stickman-turnaround
prefix: Character turnaround model sheet of exactly the same character as the reference image: a smooth matte dark-charcoal stylized stickman with a big round head, angry slanted white eyes, a small thin orange-red smirk, a slim rounded torso, long smooth tube-shaped arms and legs of even thickness, simple hands with a thumb and fingers, small rounded feet. Keep the body proportions exactly as in the reference (head size, torso length, long arms and legs); do not make it chibi, do not shorten the limbs.
suffix: Three full-body views side by side, left to right: FRONT view, LEFT SIDE view (pure profile, facing left), BACK view. Orthographic, same scale and same height, all three feet on one horizontal baseline, evenly spaced, nothing overlapping. Neutral A-pose: standing straight, arms hanging about 45 degrees away from the body, palms facing the thighs, fingers relaxed, legs straight with feet slightly apart. 3D render, soft even studio light, plain pure white background, no shadows on the background, clean silhouettes. No text, no labels, no watermark.

items.prompt: Character design reference for a 3D modeler.
